description:
WSS9 Max curved display smartwatch with Bluetooth calling is made for people who want a big, immersive screen and clear wrist calling at a value price. The large curved HD display (approx. 2.1–2.2 inches) gives an edge-to-edge look that makes caller ID, messages, and app alerts easy to read in one glance—great for workdays, commutes, and workouts. Pair it to your phone and take calls from the watch using the built-in mic and speaker when your hands are busy.

Stay on top of your routine with daily activity and wellness tracking, plus multiple movement modes that help you stay consistent. The metal-style body adds a premium feel, while the comfortable strap keeps it wearable all day. With up to 4 days typical battery life and simple magnetic charging, WSS9 Max is a practical big-display smartwatch for Android and iOS users who want strong visuals and everyday smart features without hassle.

features: Large curved HD display (approx. 2.1–2.2"): Big, immersive screen for easy reading of notifications, caller ID, and watch faces.
Bluetooth calling with mic + speaker: Make and receive calls from your wrist when paired to your smartphone—useful during commutes, cooking, and workouts.
Smart notifications all day: Get call alerts, messages, and supported app notifications so you stay updated without pulling out your phone constantly.
Smooth touch navigation: Responsive touch interface for quick swipes, taps, and menu access.
Activity & movement tracking: Tracks daily movement and activity modes for routine fitness awareness and consistency.
Metal-style premium look: Refined body design that looks sharp for office wear while staying comfortable for daily use.
Up to 4-day typical battery: Less charging stress for regular users; actual backup varies by calling, brightness, and notifications.
Magnetic charging: Simple snap-on charging for quick top-ups and easy everyday use.
